images.title: Beyond the Single Timeline: Retrocausal Access via Parallel Qudit Sheets
Reformulating Time Travel: From Emergent Time to Retrocausal State Reconfiguration

accompanying_text.text: This mathematical architecture provides a completely non-perturbative quantum information framework for time travel and multi-dimensional co-existence that preserves causality without creating logical paradoxes. By redefining space and time as emergent states generated by microscopic quantum gates—rather than a fixed background map—it proves that multiple realities can share the same physical hardware because their states are locked into decoupled, block-diagonal sectors. When a system moves backward in time, it does not travel along its own historical path; instead, it uses a localized matrix inversion to shift its matter pattern into an independent, parallel temporal sheet. The framework integrates the Unitary Anomalous Master Ward Identity (uAMWI) as a strict causality firewall, which mathematically identifies paradoxes as light-cone pinch singularities and zero-sums their probability amplitudes into a null ideal, ensuring that changing the past on an alternate sheet leaves our original present completely stable, bounded, and immune to quantum noise collapse.
